label: Satisfiability don't cares
subgoals: Write y_i XOR f_i for each internal node
Take the union over the nodes as the network SDC
Project the impossible points onto a node's local inputs

label: Impossible local patterns
subgoals: Simulate all input vectors and record the local patterns that appear
Complement the reachable set to get the controllability don't cares
Use image computation or SAT when the window is too large to simulate

label: Minimizing a node with them
subgoals: Mark the unreachable local patterns as don't cares
Run two-level minimization of the node with those don't cares
Accept the result as equivalent in context, not in isolation
